pages.text: A $(l:complicated_bees:machines/mellarium)Mellarium$() can produce thousands of combs every bee tick. You'll need something a little more powerful than a regular centrifuge (or even multiple!) to process those.$(br2)This is where the Gyrofuge comes in - a multiblock solution to your overproduction woes.

The Gyrofuge (without upgrades) processes combs in half the time and provides a baseline 1.5x multiplier to product chance. This and other aspects of the Gyrofuge can be upgraded using modules, similar to the Mellarium.$(br2)It is also important to note that $(l)non-base gyrofuge blocks can not be placed in the top layer$() of the Gyrofuge.
Try not to build these across chunk borders, or right next to each other.

pages.title: Frame Housings
pages.text: Frame Housings can hold frames based on their tier - the basic can hold one, the regular two, and the large three. These frames will stack multiplicatively.
